requirement: When at least one predecessor was pinned and successors exist, the response must include a reminder to consider successor pinning.

inputs.contents:

justification: Reviewed scenarios: A pinned/scheduled predecessor with an unscheduled successor produces both reminders; deletion produces no reminders. The implementation emits review reminder only for prior review plus unscheduled successors and pin reminder only for prior pin plus any successor; every response includes the string array.
